input.question: Would it take an obese person the same amount of time to die of starvation as a skinny person?
input.ground_truth: No. There is at least one case study of an obese person living for iirc 10 months on nothing but water and vitamin pills, with no adverse effects. In fact his health improved significantly on account of losing around a hundred kg. Meanwhile very skinny persons will die within weeks if not eating.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Would it take an obese person the same amount of time to die of starvation as a skinny person?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay, let's imagine you and your friend both didn't eat for a very, very long time.

If you are bigger (like if you have more toys in your toy box), your body has more "food stored up" inside you, like energy saved for later. So, it takes your body longer to use up all that stored energy.

If your friend is smaller (like having fewer toys), they don't have as much stored up, so it takes them less time before their body starts to have a problem.

So, a bigger person can go without food for more days than a smaller person before getting very sick from not eating. But both will get sick if they don't eat for too long, no matter how big or small they are.
